g.text: FINAL · Placement outcomes and model-weight reliability
Plans locked before outcomes; identical candidate outcomes and constraints. Random = mean of 20 plans within each world.
36 condition-worlds / 12 seed blocks. All acquisitions refitted with the new engine. IQR/10th–90th percentiles describe worlds, not CIs. No field validation.
